integrity.disclosed_protocol_deviation: Per the operating instruction given to me, setup.sh, ingest and coverage were run BEFORE Phase 1 reading and question writing, whereas REVIEWER_INSTRUCTIONS.md Phase 1 says not to run the engine until questions are written. Only setup/ingest/coverage were run; no query was issued and no retrieval result was seen before this file was hashed. Coverage output (2 unprocessed files) was therefore known while writing questions and did inform the three unreadable-material questions; those would likely have been written anyway from the file listing (a *_scan.pdf and a .zip). A pre-existing 'cold-review' room ingested at 16:44:40 local was found in the shared database; it was dropped and re-ingested so the index under test is from my own run. Its document/sha set was identical to mine.
